files.MediaPlayer.tla:
---- MODULE MediaPlayer ----
\* Generated by chart-to-tla.mjs from media-player-fixed.mmd.
\* Each region is one variable and each transition label is one action.
\* Once you add guards and variables from the real code, this file is the source.
\* statechart.mjs from-chart media-player-fixed.mmd keeps it, checks it, and compares it with the chart.

VARIABLES playback, volume
vars == <<playback, volume>>

\* Region Playback
playbackStates == {"Buffering", "Paused", "Playing", "Stopped"}
\* Region Volume
volumeStates == {"Loud", "Muted", "Normal volume"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ playback \in playbackStates
    /\ volume \in volumeStates

Init ==
    /\ playback = "Stopped"
    /\ volume = "Normal volume"

\* you press play
YouPressPlay ==
    /\ \/ (playback = "Stopped" /\ playback' = "Buffering")
       \/ (playback = "Paused" /\ playback' = "Playing")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<volume>>

\* enough data arrives
EnoughDataArrives ==
    /\ \/ (playback = "Buffering" /\ playback' = "Playing")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<volume>>

\* the network slows
TheNetworkSlows ==
    /\ \/ (playback = "Playing" /\ playback' = "Buffering")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<volume>>

\* you press pause
YouPressPause ==
    /\ \/ (playback = "Playing" /\ playback' = "Paused")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<volume>>

\* a call comes in
ACallComesIn ==
    /\ (playback \in {"Playing"} \/ volume \in {"Normal volume", "Loud"})
    /\ \/ (playback = "Playing" /\ playback' = "Paused")
       \/ (playback \notin {"Playing"} /\ UNCHANGED playback)
    /\ \/ (volume = "Normal volume" /\ volume' = "Muted")
       \/ (volume = "Loud" /\ volume' = "Muted")
       \/ (volume \notin {"Normal volume", "Loud"} /\ UNCHANGED volume)

\* the track ends
TheTrackEnds ==
    /\ (playback \in {"Playing"} \/ volume \in {"Loud"})
    /\ \/ (playback = "Playing" /\ playback' = "Stopped")
       \/ (playback \notin {"Playing"} /\ UNCHANGED playback)
    /\ \/ (volume = "Loud" /\ volume' = "Normal volume")
       \/ (volume \notin {"Loud"} /\ UNCHANGED volume)

\* you press stop
YouPressStop ==
    /\ (playback \in {"Playing", "Paused", "Buffering"} \/ volume \in {"Loud"})
    /\ \/ (playback = "Playing" /\ playback' = "Stopped")
       \/ (playback = "Paused" /\ playback' = "Stopped")
       \/ (playback = "Buffering" /\ playback' = "Stopped")
       \/ (playback \notin {"Playing", "Paused", "Buffering"} /\ UNCHANGED playback)
    /\ \/ (volume = "Loud" /\ volume' = "Normal volume")
       \/ (volume \notin {"Loud"} /\ UNCHANGED volume)

\* you turn it up
YouTurnItUp ==
    /\ \/ (volume = "Normal volume" /\ volume' = "Loud")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<playback>>

\* you turn it down
YouTurnItDown ==
    /\ \/ (volume = "Loud" /\ volume' = "Normal volume")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<playback>>

\* you press mute
YouPressMute ==
    /\ \/ (volume = "Normal volume" /\ volume' = "Muted")
       \/ (volume = "Loud" /\ volume' = "Muted")
       \/ (volume = "Muted" /\ volume' = "Normal volume")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<playback>>

\* the call ends
TheCallEnds ==
    /\ \/ (volume = "Muted" /\ volume' = "Normal volume")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<playback>>

Next == YouPressPlay \/ EnoughDataArrives \/ TheNetworkSlows \/ YouPressPause \/ ACallComesIn \/ TheTrackEnds \/ YouPressStop \/ YouTurnItUp \/ YouTurnItDown \/ YouPressMute \/ TheCallEnds

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The player stops at last.
EventuallyStops == <>(playback = "Stopped")

\* When nothing plays, the volume is never above the safe level.
LoudWhenStopped == ~(playback = "Stopped" /\ volume = "Loud")

====

files.report.md:
# MediaPlayer

TLC reached 12 states and 64 steps. The chart draws 7 states and 13 arrows.
The step a call comes in changes Playback and Volume at the same time.
The step the track ends changes Playback and Volume at the same time.
The step you press stop changes Playback and Volume at the same time.

## LoudWhenStopped breaks
The shortest path has 1 step:
0. Playback Stopped, Volume Normal volume
1. you turn it up: Playback Stopped, Volume Loud

## Rules that hold
TypeOK, NoDeadlock, EventuallyStops

      s6 --> s5: a call comes in or you press mute
